item.title: What Is Alzheimer’s Disease?
item.description: Alzheimer’s disease is a serious brain disorder that leads to memory loss and cognitive decline. Learn more about its symptoms, risk factors, and treatment options.

item.description: Certain foods can worsen hemorrhoid symptoms by triggering constipation, dehydration, or irritation. Here are 7 foods to avoid with hemorrhoids, according to experts.

item.title: Can You Treat Appendicitis With Antibiotics?
item.description: Appendectomy is the standard treatment for appendicitis, but doctors may use antibiotics alongside surgery and sometimes even instead of an appendectomy.

item.title: The ‘Invisible’ Burden of Atopic Dermatitis: Why Your Dermatologist Needs to Hear About Your Mental Health
item.description: Many eczema patients skip the mental health talk. Learn how to discuss anxiety and depression with your dermatologist to unlock better treatment options and systemic therapies.

item.title: What Is GABA?
item.description: GABA is a neurotransmitter that plays an important role in behavior, cognition, and the body’s response to stress. Prescription medications and some supplements may help increase GABA.

item.title: What Is Bronchiectasis?
item.description: This chronic lung condition causes your airways to become permanently widened and scarred. Learn how to spot and treat this incurable condition.

item.title: CDC Raises Alert on Polio Risk Abroad as Americans Prepare for Spring and Summer Travel
item.description: England, Germany, Spain, and other countries in Europe as well as others in Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean may pose heightened risk, the agency says.

item.title: 7 Tips for an IgA Nephropathy (IgAN) Diet That’s Low in Sodium and Still Flavorful
item.description: Cutting down on sodium when you have IgAN can help preserve your kidney function. Learn ways to drop salt without forgetting about flavor.
